pages.ja:
少女は空を見上げている。
灰色の陽射しは少女の銀髪を曇らせ、赤い瞳に影を落としていた。
「……そうね。シロウが帰ってきたら、言わなくっちゃ」
誰に語るでもなく、銀髪の少女は独白する。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
The girl looks up at the sky.

Gray sunlight dims her silver hair and casts shadows over her crimson eyes.

“…Yes. I'll have to tell Shirou when he comes back.”

Speaking to no one, the silver-haired girl—Illyasviel—murmurs to herself.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The girl is looking up at the sky.
The gray sunlight dulls her silver hair and red eyes.
“…Yeah. I have to tell Shirou once he comes home.”
Illyasviel talks to herself.

pages.ja:
衛宮邸は静かだった。
士郎も凛も桜を捜しに行った。
ライダーは当然のように姿を現さず、屋敷にはイリヤしかいない。
「
大空洞。二百年前に作られた、一番初めの約束の土地。この感じじゃ、もう起動が始まってる」
冬木の町で行われる聖杯戦争はこれで五度目。
聖杯を降ろす場所は毎回違ったけれど、今回は初まりの場所に還ってきた。

pages.en:
The Emiya residence is quiet.

Shirou and Rin have both gone to search for Sakura.

Rider has naturally declined to appear, leaving Illya alone in the house.

“—The Great Cavern—the Cup of Heaven. The land of the first covenant, made two hundred years ago. From the way it feels, activation has already begun.”

This is the fifth Holy Grail War held in Fuyuki.

Though each war chose a different site at which to summon the Grail, this time the ritual has returned to the place where it began.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The Emiya household is quiet.
Shirou and Rin went to find Sakura.
Rider, naturally, is nowhere to be seen, leaving Illya as the only one here.
“
The giant cavern. The promised land built two hundred years ago. From the feel of it, it’s already activated.”
This is the fifth Holy Grail War in Fuyuki.
The Holy Grail has been summoned into different places each time, but it has returned to the original site for this war.

pages.ja:
それも当然だ。
この土地にある四方の門を利用し、失敗する度に次の門を利用していく。
一度目は柳洞寺。
二度目は遠坂邸。
三度目は丘の教会。
四度目はあの焼け野原。
となれば、今回の降霊は一度目の土地に戻る。
初まりの土地。
聖杯戦争という儀式を作り上げている、あの偽りの理想郷に。

初まりの土地。

pages.en:
Naturally.

The ritual makes use of four gates around this land, moving to the next each time it fails.

The first was Ryuudou Temple.

The second, the Tohsaka residence.

The third, the church upon the hill.

The fourth, that scorched wasteland.

And so this fifth summoning returns to the first site.

The land of beginnings.

That false utopia whose rules sustain the ritual called the Holy Grail War.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It’s only natural.
They use one of the gates located at the four compass points, and move on to the next when one fails.
The first was the Ryuudou Temple.
The second was the Tohsaka household.
The third was the church on top of the hill.
The fourth was that burned field.
Then this summoning returns to the site of the first.
The point of origin.
The false utopia that sets the rules of the Holy Grail War.

pages.ja:
「
英霊の魂で満ち足りた聖杯。
それを以って門を開くのが彼らが目指した奇跡だけど……まさか、開けてもいないのに中に棲んでしまうモノがでるなんて」
滑稽ね、とイリヤは呟く。
こうなってはアインツベルンの悲願も何もない。
彼らは失敗した。
これから起きること、これから生まれるものは彼らが望んだものとはかけ離れた“災厄”である。

「

pages.en:
“—A Holy Grail filled with the souls of Heroic Spirits.

“Opening the gate with it was the miracle they sought… But who could have imagined that something would take up residence inside before they even opened it?”

How absurd, Illya murmurs.

The Einzberns' dearest wish has become meaningless.

They failed.

What will happen now—what will be born—is a “calamity” utterly removed from anything they desired.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
A Holy Grail filled with the souls of heroic spirits.
Using it to open the gate is the very miracle they aimed for… But I didn’t expect its contents to come out before the gate had been opened.”
Illya murmurs in disbelief.
This is far away from the Einzbern’s dearest wish.
They have failed.
The disaster that will be born is a far cry from what they wished for.

pages.ja:
「……放っておけばいい。わたしの役目は開ける事だもの。閉じろなんてコト、誰もわたしに言わなかった」
それに、今から調停に赴いたところで閉じられる筈がない。
聖杯としての能力は、いまや間桐桜が勝っている。
マキリの聖杯が開いた門は、アインツベルンの聖杯では手が出せない。
間桐臓硯は同じモノを開いたつもりで違うモノを開いたのだ。
それを理解しているのは聖杯である少女と、同じく聖杯に変えられた間桐桜だけ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“…I could simply leave it alone. My role is to open the gate. No one ever told me to close it.”

Besides, even if she went to intervene now, she could never close it.

As a Holy Grail, Sakura Matou's capacity now surpasses her own.

The Einzbern Grail cannot interfere with a gate opened by the Makiri Grail.

Zouken Matou believed he had opened the same thing, but opened something else entirely.

Only the girl who is a Grail and Sakura Matou, who was likewise transformed into one, understand that truth.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I can just leave it be. My role is to open it. Nobody told me anything about closing it.”
And she couldn’t possibly close it, even if she tried.
Matou Sakura excels her in ability as the Holy Grail.
Einzbern’s Holy Grail cannot do anything to the gate opened by Makiri’s Holy Grail.
Matou Zouken thinks he opened the same gate, but in reality, he opened a completely different one.
The only ones aware of this are the Holy Grails: the girl and Matou Sakura.

pages.ja:
「
間に合うかな、シロウ。シロウが間に合うなら、一緒に、どこか遠くに逃げてもいいけど」
ぼんやりと空を見上げる。
少女は迷っていた。
自身に課せられた責務と、自身に生まれた欲求のどちらを選ぶべきか迷っている。
pages.jaRuby:
「
間に合うかな、シロウ。シロウが間に合うなら、一緒に、どこか遠くに逃げてもいいけど」
ぼんやりと空を見上げる。
少女は迷っていた。
自身に課せられた責務と、自身に生まれた欲求のどちらを選ぶべきか迷っている。
pages.en:
“—Will you make it in time, Shirou? If you do, I suppose the two of us could run somewhere far away together.”

She gazes vaguely at the sky.

The girl is wavering.

She cannot decide between the duty imposed upon her and the desire born within her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Will Shirou make it? I could run away with him if he does.”
She looks up at the sky.
The girl is wavering.
She doesn’t know whether to choose the role imposed on her or the desire born from within her.

pages.ja:
「でもねシロウ。どっちにしたって、死んじゃうコトに変わりはないんだよ」
結果は同じ。
聖杯として門に向かっても、このまま逃げても死ぬだけだ。
なら
自分の本当はどちらなのだろう、と少女は灰色の空に問いかけ続ける。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“But Shirou, whichever I choose, I will still die.”

The outcome is the same.

Whether she proceeds to the gate as the Holy Grail or flees as she is, only death awaits her.

Then which choice reflects her truest self? The girl continues to ask the gray sky.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But Shirou. It makes no difference to the fact that I’m going to die.”
The result is the same.
Regardless of whether she goes to the gate as the Holy Grail or runs away, she will die.
Which is her true self? She asks the gray sky for an answer.

pages.ja:
“
”
だから気がつかない。
玄関をくぐり、「ただいま」と声をかけて帰ってきた人影に。
衛宮邸に張られた結界をすり抜けたのか、それとも結界は彼女を“侵入者”とみなさなかったのか。
pages.jaRuby:
“
”

pages.en:
“————”

And so she does not notice.

She does not notice the figure who passes through the front door and calls, “I'm home.”

Did she slip through the bounded field surrounding the Emiya residence, or did the field simply fail to recognize her as an “intruder”?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
That’s why she doesn’t notice.
The person who came through the door with an “I’m home.”
Did she slip through the boundary field, or did it not consider her a trespasser?

pages.ja:
“
”
ゆっくりと。
足音も立てず、居間から中庭に移動した彼女は、中庭で佇む少女の肩に、ゆっくりと手を、
「
随分遅いお帰りね、桜。今まで何処に行ってたの」
pages.jaRuby:

”

pages.en:
“————”

Slowly—

without making a sound, she crosses from the living room into the courtyard. Slowly, she reaches one hand toward the shoulder of the girl standing there—

“—You took your time coming home, Sakura. Where have you been?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
Slowly.
She moves from the living room to the yard without a sound, then reaches out to the girl sitting at the porch.
“
You’re home late, Sakura. Where were you?”

pages.ja:
「
姉、さん」
侵入者
間桐桜の腕が止まる。
彼女は目の前のイリヤから視線を外し、中庭で待っていた遠坂凛だけを見た。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“—Rin.”

The intruder—Sakura Matou—stops her hand.

She looks away from Illya and fixes her gaze solely upon Rin Tohsaka, who was waiting in the courtyard.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Nee-san…”
The trespasser, Matou Sakura, stops her hand.
She looks away from Illya and to Tohsaka Rin, who has been waiting for her in the yard.

pages.ja:
「イリヤから離れなさい。それ以上近づいたら容赦なく撃ち抜くわ」
それが脅しではない事は、この場にいる全員が判っている。
「
無駄なコトなのに。まあ、それでリンの気が済むならいいけど」
驚いた様子もなくイリヤスフィールは歩き出す。
少女は間桐桜と遠坂凛
二人の対峙を傍観するように、中庭の端まで歩いていった。

pages.en:
“Step away from Illya. Come any closer, and I'll shoot straight through you without hesitation.”

Everyone present knows it is no idle threat.

“—What a pointless gesture. Still, if it makes you feel better, I don't mind.”

Without the slightest surprise, Illyasviel begins to walk.

As though withdrawing to observe the confrontation between Sakura Matou and Rin Tohsaka, she moves to the edge of the courtyard.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Get away from Illya. I’ll shoot you down if you get any closer to her.”
Everyone here knows it’s no empty threat.
“
It’s useless. Well, go ahead if it’ll satisfy you, Rin.”
Illyasviel starts walking without showing any surprise.
The girl walks to the edge of the yard, as if to watch over the two’s confrontation.

pages.ja:
「……そう。初めからここで待っていたんですね、姉さん。わたしがイリヤちゃんを誘いに来ると読んでたんだ」
「まあね。わたしには士郎と違って、アンタを助ける理由がないもの。いよいよとなったらイリヤを攫いに来るのは明白でしょ。そうでなくても一度前科があるんだから、イリヤを見張るのは当然よ」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“…I see. You were waiting here from the beginning, Rin. You knew I would come to invite Illya along.”

“More or less. Unlike Shirou, I have no reason to save you. It was obvious you would come to abduct Illya once matters reached this point. Even if it hadn't been, you had already tried once before. Of course I kept watch over her.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I see. You were waiting here all along, Nee-san. You knew I was coming for Illya-chan.”
“Yeah. I don’t have a reason to save you, unlike Shirou. It was obvious that you’d come to kidnap Illya when the time came. You’ve done it once before, so I’d be foolish not to keep an eye on her.”

pages.ja:
士郎、という響きに桜の眉が揺れる。
不愉快だ、と。
以前の彼女を知る者なら目を疑うほどの、それは露骨な嫌悪だった。
pages.jaRuby:
士郎、という響きに桜の眉が揺れる。
不愉快だ、と。
以前の彼女を知る者なら目を疑うほどの、それは露骨な嫌悪だった。
pages.en:
Sakura's brow twitches at the sound of Shirou's name.

Displeasure.

The naked hatred upon her face is so unlike her former self that anyone who knew her would doubt their eyes.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Sakura’s brows twitch at Shirou’s name.
Showing unhappiness.
She shows undisguised hatred that would surprise anyone who knew her previous self.

pages.ja:
「……ひどいな。姉さんはいつもそう。そうやって極め付けて、わたしを馬鹿にするんです。自分は綺麗だからって、汚れたわたしを見下している。
……ほんとうにいやな人。ねえ、姉さん。わたし、そんなに悪い子ですか？」
感情のない声。
それ故に寒気のする質問に、
pages.jaRuby:
「……ひどいな。姉さんはいつもそう。そうやって極め付けて、わたしを馬鹿にするんです。自分は綺麗だからって、汚れたわたしを見下している。
……ほんとうにいやな人。ねえ、姉さん。わたし、そんなに悪い子ですか？」
感情のない声。
それ故に寒気のする質問に、
pages.en:
“…How cruel. You always do this, Rin. You make up your mind about me and mock me. Because you're so pure, you look down upon me for being filthy.

“…You really are a hateful person. Tell me, Rin. Am I such a wicked girl?”

The question is spoken without emotion—and for that very reason, it chills the blood.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…That’s terrible. You’re always like that, Nee-san. You always make fun of me. You’re beautiful, so you look down on me because I’m dirty.
You’re absolutely hateful. Nee-san. Am I that bad of a person?”
Her voice contains no emotion.
The question alone should send a chill up anyone’s spine.

pages.ja:
「あったりまえじゃない。この家を出た時点で救いきれない大馬鹿よ。アンタは間桐桜を守りたがってたヤツを、最後まで信じてやらなかったんだから」
きっぱりと、遠坂凛は断言する。
pages.jaRuby:
「あったりまえじゃない。この家を出た時点で救いきれない大馬鹿よ。アンタは間桐桜を守りたがってたヤツを、最後まで信じてやらなかったんだから」
きっぱりと、遠坂凛は断言する。
pages.en:
“Obviously. The moment you left this house, you became an irredeemable fool. You refused, until the very end, to trust the person who wanted to protect Sakura Matou.”

Rin Tohsaka delivers the verdict without hesitation.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Of course. You’re a big idiot who gave up her chance to be saved the instant she stepped out of this house. You didn’t trust the person that Matou Sakura wanted to protect.”
But Tohsaka Rin gives a firm reply.

pages.ja:
「ぁ
」
間桐桜の視線が下がる。
その事実だけは、本当に間違いだったと認めるように。
pages.jaRuby:
「ぁ
」
間桐桜の視線が下がる。
その事実だけは、本当に間違いだったと認めるように。
pages.en:
“Ah————”

Sakura Matou lowers her eyes.

As though that fact alone is a mistake she truly acknowledges.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh
”
Sakura looks down.
As if acknowledging the truth of her mistake.

pages.ja:
「でも、わたしは」
「それが最良だと思った、なんて言わないで。わたしたちは外に出るなって言ったのよ。それに異論があったならまず相談しろっていうのよ。
なのにアンタは黙って出て行った。一人きりで、今までとまったく同じ失敗を繰り返した。
本当に呆れたわ。そんな事も守れないから、他人にいいようにつけこまれるのよ、アンタは」
pages.jaRuby:
「でも、わたしは」

本当に呆れたわ。そんな事も守れないから、他人にいいようにつけこまれるのよ、アンタは」
pages.en:
“But I—”

“Don't tell me you thought it was for the best. We told you not to leave. If you disagreed, you should have spoken to us first.

“Instead, you slipped away without a word. Alone, you repeated exactly the same mistake you have always made.

“It is honestly pathetic. You let other people exploit you precisely because you cannot follow even so simple a request.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But I…”
“Don’t say you thought it was for the best. We told you not to go outside. If you had any objections, you should’ve come and talked with us first.
But you went without saying anything. You went alone and made the same mistake you always made.
Unbelievable. People take advantage of you because you can’t do something as simple as that.”

pages.ja:
「……そうですね。確かに、今まではそうでした。
けど姉さん。わたし、もう弱くなんてありません。これからは、姉さんが家に籠もっていてください。先輩は、わたしが守りますから」

「
っ」

っ」

pages.en:
“…Yes. That was true until now.

“But Rin, I'm not weak anymore. From now on, you can stay shut inside the house. I will protect Shirou.”

A gaze gone cold, and an ominous shadow spilling from her body.

“————!”

At the confirmation that her suspicions were right, Rin Tohsaka cannot help retreating half a step.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…You’re right. I was definitely like that until now.
But Nee-san. I’m not weak anymore. You’re the one who can stay in the house now. I’ll protect Senpai.”
Her cold stare, the emitting ominous shadow…
“
”
Realizing that it’s as she feared, Rin takes a step back.

pages.ja:
その焦りが。

The difference in their powers will never be overturned.
But Sakura is firmly convinced that she will lose if they fight again.

そう、震える自分に言い聞かせ、掌を広げる。

pages.en:
So she must kill her here.

Merely draining her magical energy and rendering her helpless is too lenient.

Just as Rin Tohsaka would do, she too must finish it here.

She tells her trembling body as much and opens her palm.
